movie.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train
movie.overview: Tanjiro Kamado, joined with Inosuke Hashibira, a boy raised by boars who wears a boar's head, and Zenitsu Agatsuma, a scared boy who reveals his true power when he sleeps, boards the Infinity Train on a new mission with the Fire Hashira, Kyojuro Rengoku, to defeat a demon who has been tormenting the people and killing the demon slayers who oppose it!

facts: Did you know one of Tanjiro's companions, Inosuke Hashibira, was actually raised by boars and always wears a boar's head? Talk about a wild upbringing!
Here's a quirky detail: Zenitsu Agatsuma, another member of the team, only reveals his true, powerful abilities when he's completely asleep! Who knew napping could be so heroic?

The team's mission on the Infinity Train is particularly grim, as they're tasked with defeating a demon that's not just tormenting people, but specifically hunting down and killing other demon slayers!
